title: Valid Palindrome
description: Two-pointer convergence: left and right walk inward comparing characters. O(n) time, O(1) extra.

notes: Always lowercase + strip non-alphanumeric for "ignore case/spaces" palindromes.
Loop condition is `l < r` (not `<=`) — the middle char trivially matches itself.
/[^a-z0-9]/g: `^` inside `[]` negates the class; `/g` makes replace replace all.

options: The middle character trivially equals itself
Anything that is NOT a lowercase letter or digit
questions.explain: ^ inside a character class negates it; /g replaces every match.

questions.q: The canonical two-pointer convergence pattern is:
options: One at 0 and one at end, walking inward
Both at the end, walking left

exercises.prompt: Fill in the canonical two-pointer palindrome check. The hard blank is the negated character class.

blanks.hint: negated class: anything NOT lowercase letter or digit

exercises.prompt: Non-palindrome input — fill the property used for length, the loop keyword, and the early-return value on mismatch.

L3.prompt: Write `isPalindrome(s)` ignoring case and non-alphanumeric. Log `isPalindrome("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama")`.
